key_insight: Neuro-VL is a specialized vision-language model that interprets complete neuroimaging examinations and discusses findings in natural language.
clinical_relevance: Its reported capabilities could support radiology reporting and longitudinal disease assessment, though clinical benefit remains to be established.
method: Trained on nearly one million neuroimaging studies from routine clinical care.
Evaluated on abnormality diagnosis, localization, description and report generation.
Tested on serial examination comparisons and resistance to misleading clinical assumptions.
evidence_signal: Across internal and international datasets, the abstract reports stronger performance than general-purpose and specialized medical models, but provides no numerical results.
watch_item: Prospective validation is needed to establish safety and effectiveness in clinical workflows.
paper_title: A frontier machine intelligence for human neuroimaging
